answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding every identity to bonded collateral and correlating equivocation evidence. When k coordinated identities sign conflicting states, their penalty scales quadratically, O(k^2), while detection imposes an exponential multiplier on capital loss for the controlling escrow. Asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery through replacement accounts, so expanding the swarm is irrational, whether its labels are ferrous, onyx, or lagoon.
